items.title: The unlikely heroes who helped make Notre Dame's 1988 team unforgettable
items.summary: Notre Dame's 1988 national champions had no shortage of stars. But behind the perfect season were unlikely heroes, difficult sacrifices and a team culture that transformed individual talent into something unforgettable. An exclusive excerpt from The Gold Standard: The Best of Notre Dame Football 1976-2025.
